name: Vow of Dawn's splash copy no longer re-hits the original target (#9207)
contract: Vow of Dawn's proc handler for id 803491 (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp) manually selects up to Amount(803492)
nearby enemies (excluding the original target) and calls Copy() once per selected neighbor, intending each
call to land on exactly that one explicit unit. 803493 (the triggered copy-damage spell) carries its own
native EffectChainTarget[0]=3, so Unit::CastCustomSpell's ordinary chain-target selection additionally
auto-picked more nearby enemies on top of the handler's own explicit unit -- including, when the original
target was the only other enemy around, re-hitting that same original target with its own splash copy.
Copy() now caps MaxAffectedTargets to 1 for this call site (SPELLVALUE_MAX_TARGETS), so the manual
neighbor-selection loop is the only thing choosing targets and the native chain expansion can no longer
widen it. With only the original target and one eligible neighbor nearby, the neighbor must still take the
splash, but the original target must take zero of its own copy.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Vow of Dawn is active on the caster
Vow of Dawn and Frostbolt share StartRecoveryCategory 133 (1000 ms); let that GCD clear
Let the direct hit, the Vow proc and its splash copy resolve
The nearby neighbor still takes the Vow of Dawn splash
The original target takes none of its own splash copy
